venues.notes_summary: Super chill Wednesday at Close Company Atlanta. It was quiet until 6pm with a few guest visiting at that point.

venues.name: D&C DC
venues.notes_summary: **DC — Thursday 3/5.** Steady night with a later push around 8; room full until ~11, then tables closed out and returning rain stopped walk-ins. Used the low point to make cuts and start closing sidework ahead of last call. Kitchen: ~14% of sales; tartare 86'd toward the end. MOD: Kevin / Cory.

venues.name: D&C EV
venues.notes_summary: **EV — Thursday 3/5.** Slow ramp to a few pushes, but overall a slow night; rain hurt. Day 2 of Toast going well; note missing drinks/updates in the new thread Courtney started in the general Slack channel. Comps $199 (4%; variety of DNLs and some industry). Top seller: First Time Listener. Door: steady cold downpour but busy in the second and third turns, slowing 11:30; Leah Kim (D&C Member from LA), friends of Bowen, and Josh, a former EMP sommelier, with a 7 top; 8pm small wave with few-minute waits; 10pm swarm of walk-in 3 and 4 tops (6 groups seated); bar and a few tables from midnight. No-show: Susan Chappelle for 2 @ 8pm (charged). Kitchen: NA.
